en: The black and white image depicts a wide, empty street in a likely European city, bordered on one side by a large, ornate, neoclassical building with arched windows and detailed stonework. A woman in early 20th-century attire walks on the sidewalk, and two children can be seen further down the street. Trees line the opposite side of the road, and in the distance, there's a tall, industrial smokestack. The street is cobblestone, there are vintage street lamps, and the scene feels calm and somewhat institutional. No visible text is present on the front.
